name: PTR character copy: a copy renamed past 12 letters completes once
contract: A copy whose name is taken on the target realm is named after the original plus its GUID in hex (PlayerDumpReader), up to MAX_PLAYER_NAME (25) letters. coa_ptr_copy_request kept copy_name at 12 letters, so under strict SQL mode the completing UPDATE failed, the request stayed pending and the target loaded it again on every poll (live PTR: 126 copies of one character, stopped only by CharactersPerRealm). The request columns hold full names and the target claims a request before loading it, so the copy loads once and the source realm reports it with its full name; a name cut back to 12 letters (non-strict SQL mode) would equal the source name, and the source realm would not announce the rename. ptr_character_copy makes this realm both the source and the target, so the name is always taken.
